dct_description_sm: To determine levels of and temporal trends in contaminants in Arctic caribou and moose in order to 1) provide information to Northerners regarding contaminants in these traditional foods, so that they may be better able to make informed choices about food consumption (including providing information for health assessments and/or advisories as required), 2) enable wildlife managers to assess possible health effects of contaminants on Arctic moose and caribou populations, and 3) further understand the fate and effects of contaminant deposition and transport to the Canadian Arctic.
dct_title_s: Monitoring of the contaminant levels in Caribou and Moose in the Canadian Arctic: making more informed decisions about food consumption
